comRegistration.example_vbscript:
Set app = CreateObject("hyperMILL.Application")
Set doc = app.OpenDocument("C:\project.hmc")
doc.CalculateAll()
doc.GenerateNC("C:\output.nc")
comRegistration.example_python:
import win32com.client
app = win32com.client.Dispatch("hyperMILL.Application")
doc = app.OpenDocument(r"C:\project.hmc")
doc.CalculateAll()
doc.GenerateNC(r"C:\output.nc")
